== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The [[Cloud Hammer]] School is a prestigious institution known for its mastery of the [[Path of the Cloud Hammer]], a discipline characterized by high mobility and significant force. Practitioners of this path often utilize [[madra]] that manifests as clouds or mist to facilitate their techniques, which can include [[binding]] [[Enforcer]] methods or creating protective hazes. The school's members are identified by a [[Goldsign]] featuring a raincloud, and many carry hammers at their hips. The school is led by an [[Underlord]] who is often associated with a stormcloud that reflects his temperament. Notable disciples include [[Renfei]], a high-ranking member of the [[Skysworn]] who possesses significant [[Authority|authority]] due to her status within the school.}}
